cells.forex: Prices, an [[economic-calendar]], interest-rate and inflation news for both currencies, and your broker's spreads and swaps.
cells.stocks: Prices and volume, company reports and filings, and the market's general mood.
cells.penny_stocks: Filings, share count changes, trading volume and any promotion activity, and whether information is reliable at all.
cells.commodities: Supply and demand news, inventories, the futures curve, and the currency it is priced in.
cells.futures: The contract specification, margin levels, the futures curve and the underlying market's own data.

caveat: What is available, how reliable it is and whether it costs money depends on the market, the venue and the provider. Check the source of any data you use.
